battle.name: 俱盧之戰
battle.brief: 前1050年前後（年代另有多說），十一王朝法老孟提霍特普二世率埃及大軍溯尼羅河北上，直抵第四瀑布的庫魯，與庫施王國軍隊正面交鋒。埃及的圓首石碑記載大勝：城邑被毀、樹林被伐、牛群被擄；努比亞方面的記載卻說王被殺。卡面這把早王朝埃及長矛，正是這支部隊在峽谷河道中最依賴的貼身兵器。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 俱盧之戰是埃及第十一王朝與南部努比亞的庫施王國在第四瀑布一線的正面衝突。埃及一方以底比斯為首都，國王孟提霍特普二世（Nebhepetre Mentuhotep II）經過多年征討已把上埃及諸州重新收歸王室，先前割據一方的「賢者」勢力相繼凋零，王室直轄的地方行政與軍隊因此恢復。軍隊以王室直屬兵為主，編制是步兵與射手兩種基本兵，步兵以長矛、斧與彎刀近身，射手為數最多的弓箭手；此外還有被王室收編的外族與沙漠雇傭兵，即中王國文獻所稱的梅德介，專任警衛、追擊與沙漠巡邏。最高指揮權在法老一身，大維齊（vizier）阿門尼等重臣只在分區作戰時代行節制；遠征的後勤完全依賴尼羅河船隊與沿岸的汲水與駐紮點。庫施一方以凱爾瑪為核心，控制第三與第四瀑布之間的河谷，並掌握這一帶的金礦、象牙與通往南方的商路。此期庫施王室在自己的記錄裡留下姓名的極少，與埃及長期往來的是被王室冊封的「庫施統治者」與地方性的「奧泰布」首領；後者原是第二瀑布至第四瀑布之間的本地酋長，過去埃及只以繳納貢賦的方式羈縻他們。兩國的實力結構因此極不對稱：埃及有組織、有文字、有成型的兵制，庫施有地利、有射手、有峽谷屏障。
countriesEn: The battle of Culu was a set-piece clash between the Eleventh Dynasty of Egypt and the Kingdom of Kush of southern Nubia on the line of the Fourth Cataract. The Egyptian side had its capital at Thebes, and the king, Mentuhotep II (Nebhepetre Mentuhotep II), after years of campaigning had brought the Upper Egyptian nomes back under the crown; the line of provincial notables who had once ruled in their own right had died out one after another, and the direct control of the crown over local administration and troops was thereby restored. The army consisted above all of troops directly held by the crown, organised into two basic arms, infantry and archers: the infantry fought at close quarters with the spear, the axe and the curved sword, while the archers were the most numerous of the men. To these were added foreigners and desert auxiliaries taken into royal service, the Medjay of the Middle Kingdom texts, employed for guard duty, pursuit and patrol in the desert. The supreme command rested with the king in his own person, and ministers such as the vizier Ameni exercised control only over operations in their own sector; the logistics of the expedition depended entirely on the Nile shipping and on the watering and halting places along the bank. The Kushite side was centred on Kerma, controlled the river valley between the Third and Fourth Cataracts, and held the gold workings, the ivory and the trade routes leading south. Very few names of the Kushite royal house survive from this period; those Egypt dealt with over the long term were the ruler of Kush appointed by the Egyptian crown and the local chiefs of the Auteib, who were native rulers between the Second and Fourth Cataracts whom Egypt had hitherto kept in line only by the payment of tribute. The balance of strength was therefore lopsided: Egypt had organisation, script and a formed military system, while Kush had terrain, archers and the barrier of the cataracts.
people: 這場戰爭留下姓名的多數來自埃及一方，而且都是間接留下名字的。孟提霍特普二世（Nebhepetre Mentuhotep II）是第十一王朝的國王，「兩女神之愛」是他王位的尊號，通行年表把他的在位年放在約前2061至前2010年之間；他是第一位在三角洲留下自身印記的埃及法老，一枚刻有其名的印璽出土於下埃及，因此可以證明他這支軍隊確實越過了南北分界。真正把戰役文字留下來的是他的王室印璽持有者兼庫施總督捷胡提（Djehuty）：他的墓在底比斯西岸謝赫·阿卜德·古爾納墓地，編號 TT104，墓中壁畫與銘文記載了一次深入努比亞的行動，以及埃及王在戰陣中的下落，構成與石碑記載相反的另一個版本。孟提霍特普二世的大維齊阿門尼（Ameni）在底比斯郊外的 TT82 墓葬自述跟著國王平定下埃及，說明王室作戰會議裡設有專職的高階將領。埃及方還有一套處理努比亞事務的官員系統，「庫施總督」是一個實職，其人選往往來自底比斯王宮，並被派駐到上游。庫施方面留下姓名的只有頭銜而非人名：一位與埃及王朝對等的「庫施王」，以及被埃及冊封、可能原本是埃及人的「庫施統治者」；另有「奧泰布」一系的本地首領，多數學者認為其一員即為俱盧的對手。孟提霍特普三世的即位則是這一戰役的另一種後果記載：他接手的是一個南方遠征之後收縮、王室威信受損的王朝。
peopleEn: Those who left a name in connection with this war are mostly on the Egyptian side, and mostly at one remove from the fighting. Mentuhotep II (Nebhepetre Mentuhotep II) was the king of the Eleventh Dynasty; the title of the Two Ladies was his royal name, and the usual chronologies place his reign between about 2061 and 2010 BC. He was the first Egyptian king to leave his own mark in the Delta, a seal carrying his name having been found in Lower Egypt, and it can therefore be shown that his army really did cross the line between north and south. The man who actually set down the account of the war was his holder of the royal seal and governor of Kush, Djehuty: his tomb lies in the necropolis of Sheikh Abd el-Qurna on the west bank at Thebes, numbered TT104, and its painted scenes and inscriptions record a deep expedition into Nubia and the fate of the Egyptian king in the battle, supplying a second version that contradicts the stela. The great vizier of Mentuhotep II, Ameni, in his tomb TT82 outside Thebes recounts having followed the king in the reduction of Lower Egypt, which shows that the royal war council included senior officers with a professional standing. Egypt also had an administrative system for Nubian affairs: the governor of Kush was a real office, its holders were usually drawn from the palace at Thebes, and were posted upriver. On the Kushite side only titles and no personal names survive: a king of Kush equal in rank to the Egyptian dynasty, and a ruler of Kush appointed by Egypt who may originally have been an Egyptian himself; alongside them stood the native chiefs of the Auteib, of whom most scholars would identify one as the adversary at Culu. The accession of Mentuhotep III is the other piece of evidence for the consequences of this battle: he inherited a dynasty that had withdrawn from the south with the authority of the crown damaged.
kits: 先說清卡面上的兵器：這是一把埃及長矛，型號上屬早王朝的銅矛頭接木杆一路傳下來的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上，埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。放到俱盧的戰場上，這把矛的意義在「收復失地」的那一半：孟提霍特普二世此行正是要把埃及的邊界重新推到上游，而中王國的長矛與早王朝的形制並無根本差別，只是矛頭改為有套筒的柳葉形銅頭，杆長約兩公尺，可用於成列的槍林與格鬥中的刺擊。埃及部隊的其他裝備包括卡爾帕什一類的彎刀、銅斧與梨形銅錘（國王所持的白色金錘是權力的象徵）、長方形或圓形蒙皮木盾，以及給近衛與步兵用的亞麻與皮革製防護；遠射兵器是複合弓與投擲棒，箭鏃多為燧石與骨。庫施一方以弓為主，努比亞的射手在埃及人自己的記載裡就是箭術見長的一方，配以短矛、標槍與皮盾，並善用峽谷內的卵石與陡岸。雙方都沒有成型的攻城器，也沒有足以攻城重裝的技術可言：這是一場野戰與峽谷遭遇戰，勝負靠的是河岸上的步戰與遠射。運輸與供應同樣靠尼羅河：船隊運人運糧，岸上隊伍靠牛、驢與人力搬運，過瀑布時還要分段搬運舟艇與貨物。
kitsEn: First the weapon on the card should be made clear: this is an Egyptian spear, a type that descends in a line from the early dynastic spear with a copper or bronze head bound to a wooden shaft; the Egyptians used it to defend city walls, and later used it to recover lost ground. Placed on the field at Culu, the significance of this spear lies in that second half, the recovery of lost ground, for the march of Mentuhotep II was precisely an attempt to push Egypt's frontier back upriver. The Middle Kingdom spear was in no fundamental respect different in form from the early dynastic type; the head had become the socketed leaf-shaped copper blade, the shaft ran to about two metres, and the weapon served both in the massed spear line and in the stab of close combat. The rest of the Egyptian equipment included curved swords of the khopesh family, copper axes and the pear-headed copper mace, the white gold mace of the king being an emblem of authority, rectangular or round wooden shields covered with hide, and linen and leather protection for the guard and the foot. Missile weapons were the composite bow and the throwing stick, with arrowheads of flint and bone. The Kushite side fought with the bow above all: the Nubian archers were renowned for their shooting in the Egyptians' own accounts, and they were equipped with short spears, javelins and hide shields, and they used the loose boulders and the steep banks of the gorge to full advantage. Neither side had developed siege engines, and neither had the armour or the technique to assault a fortified town: this was a field battle and a gorge engagement, decided by close fighting on the bank and by shooting at range. Transport and supply rested on the Nile in the same way: boats carried men and grain, the parties on shore used oxen, donkeys and human porters, and at the cataracts the hulls and cargoes had to be carried in stages and relaunched.
tactics: 俱盧之戰的作戰過程只能從地理與制度倒推其骨架，具體的陣形細節沒有留下文字。埃及遠征的難點全在河道：從底比斯到第四瀑布，順流下行容易，逆流而上則要靠成隊的船與岸上的牽引隊，舟艇必須在瀑布處卸下、搬過岩灘再重新下水，這是這條路線自古以來最費時的一段。船隊按編隊推進，前鋒是弓手與近衛混編的先遣船，主力船隊載著步兵與糧食，後面跟著運糧隊與預備隊。行軍按站分段，汲水點、駐紮地與餵飼地都選在河灣與支汊的背風處，這是隊伍能維持的唯一補給鏈。接近第四瀑布時，河道收窄、亂石與急流把戰場切成一段段狹窄的走廊，庫施軍隊佔據兩岸高處與城邑，以弓手覆蓋通道；埃及軍隊因舟船難以展開成大縱隊，只能在峽口逐點攻入，狹地之中長矛與短兵交接，弓手在舟上與兩側岩壁掩體之後射擊。戰後埃及方面記載摧毀城邑、砍伐樹木、擄走牛群，說明這次遠征帶有破壞性打擊與掠奪物資的性質，目標是拆掉對方的據點與經濟基礎，而非長期駐防。整體戰術意圖是：先在峽口消耗對方，再沿河推進到第四瀑布，建立一個由王室直接派員的新的邊疆節點，把對方首領的世襲權力換成埃及的任命。
tacticsEn: The course of the battle at Culu can only be reconstructed backwards from geography and institutions; no text preserves the details of the formations. The whole difficulty of the Egyptian expedition lay in the river. From Thebes to the Fourth Cataract the going downstream was easy, while the ascent had to be made with boats in company and parties hauling on the bank; the hulls had to be unloaded above the cataracts, carried past the rock and launched again, and that was by far the slowest stage of the route since the earliest times. The flotilla moved in divisions, with a vanguard of mixed archers and picked troops in the leading boats, the main body carrying infantry and grain, and behind them the supply boats and the reserve. The march was broken into stages, with watering places, halting grounds and the grazing for the animals chosen in the lee of river bends and side channels, and these were the only chain of supply the column could keep. As the Fourth Cataract approached the channel narrowed and the rocks and rapids cut the ground into a series of short corridors; the Kushite troops held the heights on both banks and the settlements, covering the passage with their archers, while the Egyptian force, unable to deploy its boats in a long line, could only work its way in point by point at the mouth of each gorge, where in the confined ground spears met short weapons and archers shot from the boats and from behind the rock cover on either side. The Egyptian account of the destruction of settlements, the felling of trees and the carrying off of cattle shows that the expedition was a raid of breaking and of plunder, aimed at dismantling the enemy's strongpoints and economic base rather than at a lasting garrison. The tactical intention as a whole was to wear the enemy down at the gorges, to advance along the river to the Fourth Cataract, and to set up a new frontier node staffed directly by men appointed from the court, so that the hereditary authority of the local chiefs was replaced by Egyptian appointment.
data: 可核對的數字不多，而且多數帶著爭議。年代：戰爭年表常把此戰記為前1050年，但孟提霍特普二世的在位年代通常定在約前2061至前2010年之間，學界多數把俱盧繫在他在位末期、臨終前一兩年，因此前1050這個寫法更可能是早期編年時的誤記，或後來轉錄的訛誤；本卡沿用戰爭年表的寫法，實際年代應以王在位末期為準。距離：由第一瀑布（阿斯旺）到第四瀑布，河道航程約六百公里；由第二瀑布（瓦迪哈勒法）到第四瀑布約三百公里，逆流而上所需時間以月計。落差：第四瀑布由數段急流與岩灘組成，總落差大致在十公尺上下。兵力：沒有任何可核的數字，石碑只提到城邑、樹木與牛群，沒有傷亡與俘虜的記載；一般研究只把遠征主力推估在數千人至數萬人之間，另有無法計算的船工、牽引隊與搬夫。碑與墓：記錄此戰的圓首石碑為石灰岩立碑，現藏大英博物館，館藏編號 EA 1120；捷胡提的墓在底比斯西岸，編號 TT104。此外沒有戰役現場的考古定點報告，第四瀑布一帶的聚落屬中王國與新王國時期，尚無被公認的戰場遺址。
dataEn: There are few numbers that can be checked, and most of them are contested. Date: tables of battles habitually record this war as 1050 BC, but the reign of Mentuhotep II is usually placed between about 2061 and 2010 BC, and most scholars connect Culu with the last years of his reign, the year or two before his death, so that 1050 BC is more likely a misdating of the early chronographers or a copying error propagated afterwards; this card follows the battle tables, but the real date should be sought in the closing years of the reign. Distances: from the First Cataract at Aswan to the Fourth Cataract the river distance is about six hundred kilometres, and from the Second Cataract at Wadi Halfa to the Fourth Cataract about three hundred, the ascent taking months. Drop: the Fourth Cataract is made up of a series of rapids and rock shelves with a total fall of roughly ten metres. Strength: no verifiable figure survives; the stela mentions only settlements, trees and cattle, with no record of losses or prisoners. Studies generally estimate the field force somewhere between several thousand and tens of thousands, excluding the boat crews, the hauling parties and the porters, which cannot be counted at all. Monument and tomb: the round-topped stela that records the battle is a standing limestone slab now in the British Museum, museum number EA 1120; the tomb of Djehuty is TT104 on the west bank at Thebes. Beyond that there is no located archaeological report of the battlefield, and the settlements of the Fourth Cataract region belong to the Middle and New Kingdom periods; no battlefield site has been generally accepted.
cause: 打起來的理由，埃及方面看有三層。第一層是邊疆治理的失敗：早王朝以來，埃及對第二瀑布以南既沒有常駐軍，也沒有關卡，只靠「奧泰布」一系的本地首領代管並繳貢；到第十一王朝，這種羈縻眼看要被整個吞掉，第四瀑布一線的金礦、象牙與南方商路一旦被對方攥住，埃及就失去南方最重要的財源與情報來源。第二層是王權重建之後的必然延伸：孟提霍特普二世把分裂時代的「賢者」清理完畢、王室直轄恢復之後，向南推進就是把中央權力延伸到南方，與他恢復南北統一是同一套邏輯。第三層是制度變更的準備：把奧泰布的世襲權力換成由底比斯直接任命、能聽懂埃及語又能調解當地事務的「庫施統治者」，這是一種行政成本的投入，需要先在軍事上壓服對手。庫施方面的動機則是防守性的反彈：以凱爾瑪為中心、以峽谷與急流為屏障的政權，本身正處在整合本地勢力的階段，埃及的深入與人事安排都是對既有權力結構的威脅；庫施也清楚埃及的軍隊無法長期駐紮在上游，峽谷中的每一道急流都是消耗來敵的關口。於是雙方在第四瀑布這個誰都退不開的位置上撞在一起。此外還有一種讀法，把此役視為孟提霍特普二世死因的一部分，認為他在遠征中陣亡，其死所引發的權力真空才真正改變了南方的版圖。
causeEn: The reasons for the clash are best read on the Egyptian side in three layers. The first is the failure of frontier government. Since the earliest dynasties Egypt had kept neither permanent troops nor checkpoints south of the Second Cataract, and had governed the region through the native chiefs of the Auteib and the tribute they paid; by the Eleventh Dynasty that arrangement looked likely to be swallowed whole, and once the gold workings, the ivory and the southern trade routes of the Fourth Cataract fell into the enemy's hands, Egypt lost its most important source of wealth and of intelligence in the south. The second is what had to follow the reconstruction of royal power. Once Mentuhotep II had cleared away the notables of the age of division and the direct control of the crown had been restored, the march south was the extension of the central authority, and it followed the same logic as his restoration of a united Egypt. The third is the preparation for a change of system: replacing the hereditary authority of the Auteib with a ruler of Kush appointed directly from Thebes, able to speak Egyptian and to settle local disputes, was an investment of administrative effort that first had to be made good by force. The Kushite motive was, by contrast, a defensive rebound. A polity centred on Kerma and shielded by gorges and rapids was itself in the stage of absorbing the local powers, and Egyptian penetration and Egyptian appointments were a threat to the existing structure of authority; the Kushites also knew well that an Egyptian army could not be garrisoned far upriver for long, and every rapid in the gorge was a gate through which an approaching enemy was worn down. The two sides thus collided at the Fourth Cataract, a position neither could decline. A further reading treats the campaign as part of the cause of Mentuhotep II's death, holding that he was killed on the expedition and that the vacuum opened by his death is what really changed the map of the south.
impact: 俱盧的結果並沒有讓埃及得到一個穩固的上游。戰後的若干年，中王國在南方維持的影響仍以第一與第二瀑布為限；真正把邊界釘死在第二瀑布的做法，要等到第十二王朝的塞努斯雷特三世，他在塞姆納等處修築要塞、樹立界碑，把關卡制度化——這說明俱盧遠征的成果並不持久，埃及是靠後來王朝的工程補回來的。國內政治受到的衝擊更大：孟提霍特普二世死後，第十一王朝迅速崩潰，阿瓦里斯的赫拉克利奧波利斯勢力重新獨立，直到孟提霍特普三世在位第十九年左右才把三角洲重新收復，首都的守備與行政一度失序。TT104 所暗示的「國王死於南方」成為解釋這一崩潰的關鍵假說之一，學界至今爭論不停。就努比亞而言，此役之後凱爾瑪並未中斷其作為獨立中心的發展，金礦開採的規模反而在中王國晚期到新王國時期急劇上升，說明南方的經濟並不依賴埃及的軍事佔領。史料上的意義更為突出：一塊歌頌式石碑與一座王陵在同一場戰役上留下互相矛盾的說法，正是中王國埃及「以碑文定調、以王陵傳世」的書寫方式最著名的案例，也提醒人把官方碑文與地方記載分開閱讀。
impactEn: The result of Culu did not give Egypt a secure upstream. For a number of years afterwards the influence the Middle Kingdom maintained in the south remained bounded by the First and Second Cataracts; the business of fixing the frontier at the Second Cataract was done by Senusret III of the Twelfth Dynasty, who built forts and set up boundary stones at Semna and elsewhere and made the checkpoint system a standing institution, which shows that the fruits of the Culu expedition did not endure and that Egypt recovered the ground only through the engineering works of a later dynasty. The shock to domestic politics was the greater. After Mentuhotep II died the Eleventh Dynasty collapsed quickly, the power of Herakleopolis at Avaris became independent again, and the Delta was not recovered until the nineteenth year or so of Mentuhotep III; the guard and the administration of the capital fell into disorder for a time. The reading of TT104, which suggests that the king died in the south, has become one of the key hypotheses offered to explain that collapse, and scholars continue to argue about it. As for Nubia, the campaign did not interrupt the development of Kerma as an independent centre, and the scale of gold working rose sharply between the late Middle Kingdom and the New Kingdom, which shows that the economy of the south did not depend on the military occupation of Egypt. The significance for the sources is even more striking. A celebratory stela and a royal tomb leaving mutually contradictory accounts of the same battle make this the most famous case of the Middle Kingdom manner of writing, in which the stela sets the tone and the tomb carries the story on; it is also a standing warning to read official monumental text and local record separately.
result: 就現有材料而言，俱盧之戰有兩個版本，兩者不可能同時成立。埃及版本記在孟提霍特普二世的圓首石碑上：國王的軍隊大勝，摧毀庫施人的城邑，砍倒他們的樹林，趕走或擄走他們的牛群，這是一場徹底的、帶破壞性的勝利，也是埃及宣傳傳統最典型的寫法。努比亞版本記在捷胡提的墓裡：埃及方面的王在戰役中敗亡，庫施方面的統治者得勢，與石碑所說的正好相反。學界多數認為兩說都帶偏：石碑免不了誇大，而墓中文字所記的敗亡也未必指整支埃及軍隊的潰滅，較穩妥的看法是埃及在峽口取得了戰術上的優勢，卻沒有把控制延伸到第四瀑布，並且很可能以國王的性命付了代價。結果是政治上的：埃及在南方推行的制度化統治沒有成功，第四瀑布的據點沒有留下來，阿瓦里斯的獨立勢力趁虛坐大，第十一王朝就此崩潰；凱爾瑪在南方維持事實上的自主，直到新王國時期才被重新納入埃及的行省體系，並以「下埃及總督」的名義加以管理。就兵器而言，這一場戰爭再一次說明長矛在埃及軍中的位置：它不是在開闊地上取勝的武器，而是峽谷與城垣攻防裡最可靠的貼身兵器，卡面所繪的早王朝矛型，正是埃及人在守城垣與收復失地之間反覆使用的同一種工具。
resultEn: On the evidence that survives, there are two versions of the battle of Culu, and they cannot both be true. The Egyptian version is inscribed on the round-topped stela of Mentuhotep II: the king's army won a great victory, destroyed the towns of the Kushites, cut down their trees, and drove off or carried away their cattle. It is a thorough and destructive victory, and it is the most typical of the Egyptian manner of writing such things. The Nubian version is in the tomb of Djehuty: the Egyptian king was defeated and lost his life in the battle, while the Kushite ruler came out on top, which is the exact opposite of what the stela says. Most scholars hold that both accounts are biased: the stela cannot avoid exaggeration, and the death recorded in the tomb need not mean that the whole Egyptian army was destroyed. The sounder view is that Egypt gained a tactical advantage at the gorges without extending its control to the Fourth Cataract, and that it may well have paid for it with the life of its king. The result was political. The institutionalised Egyptian control in the south did not take root, no foothold was left at the Fourth Cataract, the independent power of Avaris grew on the strength of the confusion, and the Eleventh Dynasty collapsed. Kerma maintained a de facto autonomy in the south until the New Kingdom brought it back into the Egyptian provincial system, where it was administered under the title of governor of Lower Egypt. As for the weapons, this battle once again sets out the place of the spear in the Egyptian army: it was not an instrument that won in open ground, but the most reliable close weapon in fighting among gorges and against walls, and the early dynastic type drawn on the card is the same tool the Egyptians used again and again between the defence of city walls and the recovery of lost ground.
